about: San Francisco Public Library (sfpl.org): search the catalog, databases and site content, find branches and their hours, and browse library events.

commands.summary: Search and filter upcoming library events by keyword, branch location, topic and audience; returns event titles, dates, branches and /events/YYYY/MM/DD/slug links

params.name: keys
params.description: Keyword search in event titles and descriptions

params.name: location
params.description: Branch location ID (taxonomy term number, e.g. 31 = Main Library). Get it from list-locations locationTerm (taxonomy-term-N → N)

params.name: audience
params.description: Audience term ID (e.g. adults, teens, kids)

commands.summary: List all SFPL branches with their weekly opening hours, today's hours, branch page URL and location ID
Search branches by keyword and optionally only those open right now; returns branch name, URL, location ID, today's hours and weekly hours

params.name: open_now
params.description: Set to 1 to show only branches open right now

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort field (weight = the site's default order)

commands.summary: Download an event as an iCalendar (ICS) text: title, start/end time, location and description
Resolve an event page URL (/events/YYYY/MM/DD/slug) to its node ID; path.currentPath is 'node/N', and N is used by get-event and get-event-ics
Look up a branch page by slug and get its location ID; path.currentPath is 'taxonomy/term/N', and N is the location filter for search-events

params.name: slug
params.description: Branch slug from list-locations url, e.g. main-library, mission-bay
